- packaging.ranges.VersionRange.is_disjoint(other) [method]: Return whether self and other share no member.

Equivalent to ``(self & other).is_empty``.

Both operands must share the same configured pre-release policy;
otherwise :exc:`ValueError` is raised.

>>> a = SpecifierSet(">=1.0,<2.0").to_range()
>>> a.is_disjoint(SpecifierSet(">=2.0,<3.0").to_range())
True
>>> a.is_disjoint(SpecifierSet(">=1.5,<2.5").to_range())
False

``self.difference(other).is_empty``: subtracting other leaves nothing
behind. A live arbitrary admission (the flag at full bounds) is only a
subset of another live one.

Both operands must share the same configured pre-release policy;

- packaging.ranges.VersionRange.is_superset(other) [method]: Return whether every member of other is also a member of self.

- packaging.ranges.VersionRange.snap_bounds(versions) [method]: Narrow finite bounds using the supplied versions.

The result never adds versions. ``contains`` and ``filter`` give the
same results for the supplied versions. Pre-release settings and
``===`` rules still apply, but do not affect the choice of bounds.
Unbounded ends and intervals containing no supplied version stay
unchanged. Calling this again with the same versions leaves the result
unchanged.
